newsitem.title: USA: US spot prods little changed on ACCESS after APIs.
newsitem.headline: US spot prods little changed on ACCESS after APIs.

text.p: U.S. spot products prices were little changed in after-hours ACCESS trade following new API data showing a moderate draw on total gasoline stocks and a larger than expected draw on distillates for the prior week, traders said.

ACCESS May heating oil prices edged about 0.16 cent higher two hours after release of API estimates of a 1.4 million barrel distillate draw the week ending April 25, including a 789,000 barrel decline in low sulfur diesel and a 624,000 draw on heating oil.
In earlier NYMEX action, heat settled a whopping 2.38 cents higher amid the approach of its May contract expiry on Wednesday.
May gasoline eked out a tiny 0.04 cent gain in ACCESS trade, after settling 1.02 cents higher on the NYMEX.

The API data showed a total U.S. gasoline draw of 408,000 barrels for the week, including a 1.6 million barrel draw on reformulated grades. In New York Harbor, reformulated grades fell by 2.0 million barrels, it said.
